fusions.name: Grey Fetter
fusions.desc: Casts a cold iron shackle at the first enemy it meets that deals 16 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Toll
fusions.desc: Slams a ring of cold links around you that deals 9 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Sundered] for 5 seconds. Costs 6% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Rebuke in Kind
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Unbowed
fusions.desc: Your armour is permanently increased by 15%.
